# Eishit Nigam — Portfolio

> AI Product Engineer and systems architect. Founder & Lead Architect of
> Paldita (also called Sugar Cube), a terminal-first AI coding agent and
> developer-infrastructure project.

## Who
Eishit Nigam. AI Product Engineer — turns AI ideas into shipped products
using LLMs, specialized tooling, and architectural judgment rather than
hand-writing model or agent code from scratch. Focused on developer tools
and AI infrastructure: sandboxed execution environments, HMAC-signed
local communication channels, and self-healing compilers.

## What Eishit builds
- Paldita (Sugar Cube) — terminal-first AI coding agent, sandboxed
  workspace ("Ghost Workspace"), HMAC-signed WebSocket channels.
  Status: in active development. Recognized as a Swiggy Builders Club —
  MCP Integration Partner. GitHub org: https://github.com/Paldita
- TRLM (Transactional Reliable Link Middleware, formerly Webhook Vault)
  — durable event and webhook delivery infrastructure for SaaS
  products: accepts events from external providers or a first-party
  backend, buffers through outages, retries failures, supports replay
  and dead-letter inspection. Status: open source, in development.
  Repository: https://github.com/Paldita/Paldita-TRLM
- UPNISO — creator-first social network. Status: in development.
- Zeronix Wearable — emotion-aware wearable AI concept. Status:
  concept/prototype.
- PPCL (Paldita Public Copyleft License) 1.0 and Paldita FairShare
  License 1.0 — a network-use copyleft license and a source-available
  commercial alternative, jointly created and owned by Eishit Nigam and
  Paldita. Status: community review, not yet formally OSI/FSF approved.
  Repository: https://github.com/Paldita/ppcl-license
